name: 螺旋楼梯塔
scope: Standalone authoring and isolated Forge QA only; no production save, instance mods, shared FT core, other author folders or API settings written.
history: Initial terrain-level fixture passed immediate four-way routes, but failed stabilization due to natural gravel falling into template air.
Test fixture moved to isolated world Y=180 with forced chunks; baseline passed full four-way 200-tick QA.
Final version extends pier to foundation, adds four wall-bearing ribs and inner corner protection, then reruns static/native/render audits. Previous reports and baseline retained under qa.
limitations: No FT core catalog, external connecting hall, idempotence, occupancy preflight or deployment tested.
No player save, full modpack client, multiplayer or FPS test. Native snapshots are machine evidence, not game screenshots.

Routes use native 0.6x1.8 AABB collision sweeps at 0.125-block intervals with 0.6 step limit, not a live player input recording. Random ticks disabled; neighbor/scheduled ticks enabled in forced chunks.
Not client screenshots and no lighting simulation.
Cutaway roof/walls only removed in preview memory; lower-floor study additionally hides upper structure.
AI design reference is not used as an output render.
The three ports are independent authoring interfaces, not connected FT runtime corridors. Main entrance feet Y=8 requires an explicit +7 floor-offset adapter; do not assume template Y=0 floor.
No new monster/loot/trade/trigger behavior or production deployment.
Software visual inspection is not a live full-modpack player walkthrough.

observations: Continuous four-flight spiral and upper threshold are visible across the four complementary cutaways.
Lower straight stair, solid side cheeks, floor opening guards and two-level interfaces are retained.
Complete roof and outer shell are present in exterior view; render cutaways do not alter exported NBT.
visual_review.evidence_level: Software NBT preview inspection, not a game client screenshot.
